title: Nithusikan01/Medical-Student-Assistant
summary: Medical-Student-Assistant 是一款针对医学生的生产级检索增强生成（RAG）助手，具备混合检索、跨编码重排序、会话感知记忆和全面的评估流程，能够从医学文档中提供准确、基于上下文的问答。，采用模块化架构，关注性能和算法优化
description: A production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant for medical students, featuring hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, conversation-aware memory, and comprehensive evaluation pipelines for accurate, context-grounded question answering from medical documents.
